card.name: Words just before a drug is named
card.fires_on: Small linking words and partial enzyme names in drug-interaction text, right before a drug or enzyme term is expected. Examples are 'with' after co-administered, 'the' after 'less than', and 'C' of CYP.

modes.label: Start of enzyme names
modes.description: The letter C or the number 4 inside CYP3A4 or CYP2C9 in interaction headings.

modes.label: Linking words in co-administration
modes.description: Words like 'with' or 'Other' that lead into a named interacting drug or class.

modes.label: Words before a drug property
modes.description: 'the' after 'less than' before duration of the drug's action.
modes.example: expected to be less than<< the>> duration of action of nalbuph

card.writes: It suppresses words for drug and medicine (in Chinese and English), so it lowers the chance of the next word being a generic 'drug' term.
card.plain: It fires on small words and enzyme-name pieces in drug-interaction text, where a specific drug name comes next rather than the word 'drug'.
